messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: repeated GPU OOMs during prefill on model redwood-large-v1 in hotpool us-west-2. Affected pods restarting. Pager: @oncall-ml. Severity: P2. Potential customer impact: streaming truncation/failed responses. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/inference/prefill-oom

oncall-ml: On it — joining bridge. Quick ask: scope + any customer-facing errors?

matt: Seeing container restarts on nodes gpu-ww-34 and gpu-ww-35. nvml reports OOM for runtime pid 17288. Snippet from pod logs: ```E runtime: CUDA out of memory when allocating 12.0GiB (total 24.0GiB)
stack: runtime+0x4f1a```

sarah: Looks like very long-context prefill from a tenant — single request with huge earlier context (~120k tokens). Immediate mitigation: trim prefill and evict KV aggressively.

jordan: Plan: temp reduce PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS and enable PREFILL_KVCACHE_EVICT. Patching hotpool env now: `kubectl set env ds/pool-hot --containers=runtime PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8192 PREFILL_KVCACHE_EVICT=true`

oncall-ml: Go for it. Also reduce per-request batch size to 4 on hotpool to lower peak mem. If noisy tenant persists we'll throttle at the ingress.

ops-bot: Patch applied to pool-hot/us-west-2. Rolling restart initiated (pods 1/12 -> 12/12).

matt: Rolling restart finished. OOMs dropped significantly; two pods still saw restarts on gpu-ww-35. I'm cordoning gpu-ww-35 and spinning up replacement node.

sarah: Also lowering KV cache threshold to 0.4 from 0.6 to force earlier eviction of prefill KVs. Putting that in the hotpool config now.

cust-ops: @oncall-ml @sarah preparing customer notification. Impact we have so far: tenant X experienced ~10% failed streams between 02:12–02:20 PST, mostly truncated prefill responses. Suggested wording: short apology, mitigated, ask clients to retry. No data leakage. Thoughts?

oncall-ml: Agree. Send short note, mention mitigation and PM follow-up. I'll own postmortem and follow-up ticket.

jordan: For a longer-term fix: enforce server-side long-prompt limiter and route >50k token requests to coldmodel fallback automatically. Will add telemetry to surface noisy tenants.

incident-bot: Incident state -> investigating. Hotpool mitigations applied; monitoring for 30m. Postmortem owner: @sarah. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood/2030001234

cust-ops: Customer notified and acknowledged. They asked for ETA for permanent fix.

oncall-ml: ETA ~48hrs for limiter rollout + telemetry. Closing active pages; keeping monitors for 2 hours. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

matt: Follow-up ops items: drain old node, collect kernel logs + core dumps for the two restarters, attach NVML traces to incident page.

sarah: Adding root-cause hypothesis to the postmortem: extremely long prefill + kvcache retention causing OOM cascade. Postmortem draft link will be in the incident page.

jordan: Filing follow-up PR for policy-based fallback + tenant-rate telemetry.

ops-bot: Monitor alert cleared in us-west-2 hotpool.

oncall-ml: Closing thread here — will update incident page with timeline and customer note. Good job team.
